allowedTopics: spirituality only when clearly labeled as interpretation

failed.definition: Only a reel that cannot pass its evidence, production, QA, or private-Drive verification gate is counted as failed. Retained local revision attempts are not counted as failed reels.

batchRoadmap.rangeRule: Batch n contains reel IDs ((n-1)*30+1) through n*30, zero-padded to four digits. Create or reuse a private Drive batch folder only when that batch is actually reached and its first evidence gate passes.
batchRoadmap.advanceRule: Advance to the next batch only after all 30 reels in the current batch are actual private-Drive-verified packages; do not mark a package complete from planning, generated assets, or an unverified upload.

sourceRegistry.location: automation/reels and matching private Drive package metadata

entries.topic: Habit formation: why 21 days is not a universal rule
Zeigarnik effect: interrupted tasks, recall, and resumption

artifactIndexes.driveRule: These indexes record verified package facts and local workflow state only. They do not create future Drive folders or duplicate existing package uploads.

directiveReconciliation.storageModel: Existing Batch_001 packages remain private and preserved. A future batch folder is created or reused only when that batch reaches its first evidence gate.
directiveReconciliation.completionRule: Only a rendered, QA-passed, source-metadata-complete and private-Drive-verified package is completed.
directiveReconciliation.automationRule: No unattended bulk video scheduler is created; the task scheduler does not establish a durable authenticated media worker.

lastInventory.basis: Read-only private Drive Batch_001 listing plus exact-package verification recorded in the Reel 0001 and Reel 0002 workflow records.

0001.topic: Habit formation: why 21 days is not a universal rule

0002.topic: Zeigarnik effect: interrupted tasks, recall, and resumption

driveCandidate.sourceCaptions: Original Hindi SRT is retained and ends at 58.5 seconds; corrected V2 Hindi SRT ends at 54.120 seconds and is paired with the accessibility revision.
driveCandidate.visualQa: Sampled V4 frames show a fully masked legacy-caption field, high-contrast Hindi captions, and an uncovered lower visual field.

package: existing independently verified research and source metadata

scheduling.reason: The current task scheduler and free media-generation quota do not establish a durable, authenticated bulk-video worker. Future scheduling requires a bounded approved workflow, source-verification gate, generation capacity, and Drive authorization check.

nextAction.description: Keep Reel 0001 and Reel 0002 private and preserved. Before any new Reel 0003 video production, independently verify a bounded source set, separate evidence from interpretation, define the creative brief, complete source/script/clip/review gates, and verify a private Drive package. Do not create a bulk-generation or recurring media schedule.
